paper_title: Memorization and Knowledge Injection in Gated LLMs
caption: Analysis on the embedding quality in Llama intermediate layers. Correct gate rate is computed as the rate of question embeddings which have the maximum inner product with the relevant passage embedding. It is computed for each dataset partition, which has 50 passage samples. Shaded area is the standard deviation across 20 dataset partitions. We found that embeddings at the input of MLP layers are better than at the input of attention layers. We choose to use last MLP layer input as embedding in the main experiments of MEGa.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the average correct gate rate across different embedding layers for four input types in gated LLMs, with the x-axis representing the “Embedding Layer” ranging from 0 to 30 on a linear scale, and the y-axis representing the “Average Correct Gate Rate” ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 on a linear scale. The plot displays four lines: a solid blue line for “Character Attention input,” a dashed blue line for “Character MLP input,” a solid red line for “Wiki Attention input,” and a dashed red line for “Wiki MLP input.” Each line is accompanied by a shaded area indicating the standard deviation across 20 dataset partitions. The “Character MLP input” line (dashed blue) starts near 0.8, peaks around layer 5 at approximately 0.92, dips to about 0.55 around layer 12, and then rises again to near 0.85 by layer 30. The “Character Attention input” line (solid blue) begins near 0.1, sharply increases to about 0.8 by layer 5, drops to approximately 0.25 around layer 12, and then fluctuates between 0.5 and 0.75 through layer 30. The “Wiki MLP input” line (dashed red) starts at approximately 0.2, rises to about 0.85 around layer 5, dips to roughly 0.35 around layer 12, and then rises again to about 0.7 by layer 30. The “Wiki Attention input” line (solid red) begins near 0.2, increases to about 0.8 by layer 5, decreases to approximately 0.35 around layer 12, and then fluctuates between 0.6 and 0.7 through layer 30.
